caveats: Only shares listed today are tested: companies delisted since are missing, which flatters results.
A breakout is filled at the range high plus one cent (or the minute's open if higher); real fills on fast stocks are often worse. The no-commission model charges 0.05% per order for this.
Relative volume uses the free IEX feed, a small share of all trading, as the live run does.
The rules come from a 2024 paper tested on 2016-2023; the years after are new to them.
